mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) compress equity discount rates through sustained monetary accommodation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate continued liquidity support.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE remains below 5.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1050 units signal sector overheating and impending policy tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1050 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO above 102.5) indicates strengthening supply capacity and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate higher corporate output.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises above 102.5, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals an impending monetary policy tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The joint signal of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market recovery phases, accelerating non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) indicate strengthening employment conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through improved consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during labor market recovery when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
